market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.3m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Same data as 1.2m question. Production at ~1.02-1.10m bpd in March 2026; analysts suggest at most 1.2m by year-end if sanctions lifted, with >2m bpd considered unlikely without deep reform. Reaching 1.3m bpd in 2026 would require both sanction relief and rapid ramp — low probability.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sustained sanction relief and rapid production ramp in 2026.
